title: The ranges of Hildegard of Bingen's chants
description: Bar chart counting Hildegard's 76 chants and chant groups by the span of their melody, in diatonic steps, as the Riesencodex gives them: 2 span an octave, 5 a ninth, 10 a tenth, 20 an 11th, 16 a 12th, 13 a 13th, 5 a 14th, 3 a 15th, none a 16th or 17th, 1 an 18th and 1 a 19th. Data: Weston 2022, appendix 1, from Corrigan's edition.
heading: CHANTS BY RANGE, IN STEPS · 76 IN ALL

source.container: Karin Weston, "An Exploration of Range, Mode and Performance Practice in Hildegard von Bingen's 'O tu illustrata'" (master's thesis, Schola Cantorum Basiliensis, 2022), appendix 1
